## RATE_LIMIT_NOTES

- **arXiv:** 1 request per 3 seconds (4 categories × 1 req)
- **GitHub Radar:** 10 req/min (authenticated), 6s gap between calls
- **Hacker News:** 1 req per item,120ms gap
- **GDELT:** 1 request per run, graceful fallback on failure
- **Hugging Face:** 1 req per 10 seconds, 1 req per dataset filter
- **Open-Meteo:** 1 request per day, free API no key required
- **Met Collection:** 1 request per 3 seconds, 7-day cache recommended
